title: Which Country Moves About Seven Centimetres Each Year?
description:
Australia drifts northeast fast enough to affect precise GPS coordinates.

Australia moves roughly 7 cm per year with the Australian tectonic plate.

Tectonic plates are constantly moving; national coordinate systems must periodically account for accumulated offset.

Over a decade, the shift can approach the length of a forearm.
